subject: goats
one_liner: A coin-sized neural implant that streams your goats' thoughts to a dashboard. The thoughts are mostly about fencing.
brand_voice_notes: Sincere consumer-neurotech founder pitch, applied to livestock and styled like a meditation app. Clinical vocabulary (telemetry, motor cortex, SLA) wrapped in soft wellness pastels, describing unmistakably goat problems. Never acknowledge the joke; the product believes in itself. Failure modes are stated flatly, as features. Surgery is referred to as 'the moment'.

hero.h1: Know what the herd is thinking.
hero.sub: Capra pairs a coin-sized neural implant with a live telemetry dashboard: rumination depth, scream transcripts, and fence-breach intent with up to 40 seconds of warning. What you do with those 40 seconds is between you and the fence.

features.title: Fence-Breach Forecasting
features.blurb: Motor-cortex telemetry flags escape intent up to 40 seconds before contact. That's 40 seconds of complete situational awareness while it happens anyway.

features.title: Scream-to-Text
features.blurb: Every scream is transcribed, timestamped, and routed to your inbox. Most transcripts read "no." It's now on the record.

features.title: Rumination OKRs
features.blurb: Set quarterly chewing targets across all four stomach compartments. Goats who miss their numbers appear in a red table. The table has never been empty.

pricing_tiers.name: Kid
perks: Fence alerts with 8 seconds of notice

pricing_tiers.name: Oracle
perks: Quarterly business review, attended by the goats

testimonials.quote: I get an alert 40 seconds before Denise hits the fence. The outcome has not changed once, but I've stopped being surprised.
testimonials.name: Carol Wetzel
testimonials.title: Owner-Operator, 14-Goat Hobby Farm, Zone 6b

testimonials.quote: The scream transcripts confirmed what we suspected: it's nothing. He's just doing it.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ferreira
testimonials.title: Assistant Regional Manager, Petting-Zoo Compliance

testimonials.quote: Capra told me my buck dreams about the recycling bins. I checked the bins. He had been in them.
testimonials.name: Ingrid Halvorsen
testimonials.title: Certified Small-Ruminant Nutritionist, semi-retired

demo_screen_concept: A live herd neural telemetry console: a grid of goat cards, each with name, ear-tag ID, a live EEG-style sparkline, current cognitive state ('ruminating', 'plotting', 'screaming', 'asleep standing up'), and a fence-breach probability meter. A right-hand feed streams scream-to-text transcripts in real time. Clicking a goat opens a detail panel with rumination OKR progress across four stomach compartments and a 'recalibrate' button that runs a confidence-inspiring progress bar and changes nothing. Filter tabs: All / Plotting / Compliant.

design_direction.style: Claymorphic pharma-DTC wellness brochure, pastel lavender daylight mode. The page is staged as the consumer site of a heavily funded neurotech company that has decided the goat is an under-instrumented mind and sells elective brain surgery with the visual language of a meditation app. A pale lavender ground (#F3F0FA) carries soft clay surfaces: cards with 24-28px radii, dual soft shadows (a pale outer drop and a faint inner top highlight) so every panel reads as squeezable, with no hard borders anywhere. Depth comes entirely from clay shadow pairs and pastel layering: no glass, no blur panels, no hairline rules as structure, no offset brutalist shadows, no bento lattice. The core motif is the implant coin: a soft 3D clay disc rendered in CSS (radial gradients + shadow pairs) that appears in the hero at pill-bottle scale, and shrinks into pill badges and bullet dots throughout. A single coral EEG squiggle (#FF7A59) is the only sharp element on the page: a thin SVG polyline that runs under the hero headline, animates through testimonial dividers, and carries every live-telemetry accent (breach meters, alert chips, the live dot). One grape violet (#6D4FC4) carries primary CTAs, active states, and the wordmark; everything else stays in plums and pastels. Fraunces (soft chunky wonky-axis serif) sets the wordmark and headlines with the warmth of a company that says 'the moment' instead of 'the surgery'; Karla carries plain, faintly clinical-trial body copy. Telemetry figures (breach probability, rumination depth, tier prices) sit in soft inset clay wells with tabular figures. Motion is spa-restrained: clay cards lift 4px and their shadows deepen on hover, buttons squish to scale(0.97) on press, the EEG line draws itself once on scroll, the live dot pulses on a 3s cycle, sections fade up 8px with a 40ms stagger, all gated behind prefers-reduced-motion. No dark mode, no neon, no terminal chrome, no serif-engraving, no signage grids, no emoji. Reads like a company that files a goat's inner life under 'engagement surface' and considers the skull a paywall.
design_direction.archetype: Consumer med-tech DTC landing: hero with implant motif + live telemetry teaser, three-step 'how the moment works', features, testimonials, pricing, footer
design_direction.motion_vocab: clay squish on press (scale 0.97), 4px hover lift with shadow deepening, EEG polyline self-draw on scroll, 3s pulse on live dots, 8px fade-up section reveals with 40ms stagger, all behind prefers-reduced-motion
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Left column: Fraunces headline over Karla sub, violet CTA pill plus ghost secondary, coral EEG squiggle underlining the key phrase. Right column: a large CSS clay implant disc floating above a soft clay telemetry chip showing one goat's live state ('DENISE — plotting, 87% breach probability') with pulsing coral dot. Pastel clay blobs at low opacity behind, spa-style.
